- REALISTIC ARTIFICIAL GREENERY: Create a fresh, natural look with a realistic artificial hanging basket featuring 34 lifelike PE leaves. Enjoy year-round greenery without watering, trimming or ongoing maintenance.

## Information
Bring lasting greenery to any space with this Artificial Hanging Basket. Featuring 34 realistic PE leaves, it provides the appearance of healthy foliage without the need for watering, pruning or maintenance. Constructed from durable UV-resistant materials, this faux hanging basket is designed for both indoor and outdoor use, helping maintain its vibrant appearance even when displayed in sunny locations. Lightweight and supplied fully assembled, it's ready to hang in minutes and is ideal for balconies, patios, porches, conservatories, living rooms and bedrooms. Whether you're brightening a garden wall or adding a touch of greenery indoors, this maintenance-free hanging basket offers year-round decorative appeal.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Peva leaves for a natural look
- Natural wooden trunk and twists
- Weighted faux cement pot
- For indoor and outdoor display

## Information
Struggle to look after houseplants Look no further than our Artificial Ficus Tree. Requires no sunlight, water, or pruning perfect if you lack green fingers! We've gone all out to make the tree as natural as possible. As well as wooden trunks, each tree has dark green stems and green leaves in three contrasting colours. For a natural look and feel, we've designed the leaves using PEVA. Plus, we've coloured them in three shades of green to capture the changing colour of real leaves when exposed to sunlight. ## Features

## Information
Plastic patio planters with bright and vibrant artificial pansies and decorative conifer/cedar topiary in the centre. Extremely realistic and life-like looking. Hard to tell they are not real from only a short distance. Pot size width 24cm, height 21cm. The overall height including the plants is approximately 60cm. Ready assembled and ready to display straightaway on your porch, patio, or garden. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use (UV protected to prevent colour fading). They can stay outside in all weather conditions all year round. However, we do advise keeping them out of extremely windy areas as strong winds May blow them over. Easy and carefree alternative to real plants and flowers. No care or attention required. No time-consuming watering, or pruning anymore, simply unpack, position, sit back and enjoy. They look fantastic pretty much anywhere in the garden or around the house but also great outside shop fronts, bars, restaurants, and hotels as well as offices, schools, and nurseries. Available with different colours: purple & yellow, soft pink & white or pink & white flowers. Please note, matching hanging baskets, rattan patio planters and window boxes are also available. The planters are packed in cardboard boxes for protection during shipment, this may cause the foliage to be a little compressed or out of shape on arrival. We recommend you spend a little time when you open the box to gently arranging the foliage by folding out branches, leaves and flower to a natural looking shape.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- This complete artificial flower arrangement set includes the vase, flowers and foliage needed to recreate the display shown in the product images. The arranged size is approximately 70cm high x 50cm wide x 50cm deep.
- The set includes one 30cm brown geometric glass vase, three 70cm artificial viburnum sprays, two 70cm artificial green berry sprays and six 70cm pink carnation stems.
- Flowers and foliage are supplied loose at full length for flexible arranging. Shorten the stems with wire cutters or fold them at the ends to fit the vase.
- The individual flowers, sprays and vase are also available separately, making it easy to add to or customise your arrangement.
- Realistic artificial flowers and foliage create an attractive decorative display without the maintenance of fresh flowers.
- Wired stems can be shaped, cut with wire cutters or folded to fit the vase and suit your arrangement.
- Includes one 30cm brown geometric glass vase, measuring 30 x 20 x 20cm, with a 9.5cm diameter top rim.
- Includes 3 x 70cm artificial viburnum sprays, 2 x 70cm artificial green berry sprays and 6 x 70cm pink carnation stems, each with four silk flowers.
- Arranged dimensions: 70cm high x 50cm wide x 50cm deep.
- Pack size: 1 complete artificial flower arrangement set.

## Information
Create an attractive artificial flower display with this complete arrangement set, including the vase, flowers and foliage shown in the product images. The finished arrangement measures approximately 70cm high x 50cm wide x 50cm deep. It includes one 30cm brown geometric glass vase, three artificial viburnum sprays, two artificial green berry sprays and six pink artificial carnation stems with four silk flowers each. The flowers and foliage are supplied loose and at full length, allowing you to shape, cut or fold the wired stems to suit your preferred display.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Realistic artificial boxwood foliage and wired stems allow you to shape the tree to suit your space.
- Stands 120 cm high with an approximately 35 cm wide boxwood ball.
- Botanically accurate artificial foliage creates a highly realistic appearance, and the tree arrives potted and ready to display.
- Place it inside a larger planter for added impact, particularly with gravel or bark around the pot. For outdoor use, apply UV protection spray annually to help maintain its appearance.
- Designed and supplied by Leaf Design UK.
- The weighted plastic pot provides a stable base for display.
- Pot dimensions, approximately 18 cm diameter x 15 cm high.
- UV-resistant plastic foliage is designed for lasting visual appeal.
- Suitable for indoor or outdoor display.
- Supplied in a weighted plastic pot for convenient placement.

## Information
Add year-round structure and greenery to your space with this realistic artificial boxwood Buxus ball topiary tree from Leaf. It stands 120 cm high and features an approximately 35 cm wide ball of botanically accurate foliage. The wired stems can be arranged to suit your space, while the weighted plastic pot keeps the tree ready for immediate display. Use it indoors or outdoors, or place it inside a larger planter filled or finished with gravel or bark for a more impressive presentation. For outdoor displays, we recommend applying UV protection spray once a year to help keep the foliage looking its best.

## Features
- UV-protected artificial cedar cypress trees with highly realistic foliage, suitable for indoor use and outdoor use in a sheltered spot.
- The trees contain no natural components. Their metal-bound central stems provide a strong, durable structure, while the wired stems can be arranged to suit your space.
- Each tree measures approximately 60 cm high and 20 cm wide when arranged as shown, with 280 leaves.
- Suitable for indoor use and outdoor use in a sheltered spot. Protect from extreme temperatures to help extend its life.
- Leaf Design UK product.
- Supplied in a plain plastic weighted pot, ready to display or place inside a larger planter.
- Each pot measures approximately 13 cm wide x 13 cm high.
- Warranty period: 1 month.
- Pack quantity: 1.
- Each tree comes in a weighted plastic pot for added stability and easy display.

## Information
Add evergreen style to your home, garden, patio or sheltered outdoor space with this pair of artificial cedar cypress topiary trees. UV-protected and designed for outdoor use, they feature realistic foliage with subtly lighter green leaf tips and 280 leaves per tree. The wired stems can be shaped to suit your space, while the metal-bound central stem provides a strong, durable structure. Each tree arrives ready to display in a plain weighted plastic pot, or you can place it inside a larger planter and cover the pot with gravel or bark for a natural finish. Each tree measures approximately 60 cm high and 20 cm wide when arranged as shown. The pot measures approximately 13 cm x 13 cm. No natural components are used.
